capabilities.description: Text-to-Speech conversion using Piper or System engines. Toggleable output.
capabilities.verification_step: Press F5, check status bar voice indicator toggles ON/OFF.
capabilities.notes: F5 toggle. Can be directed to Local or Web UI.

capabilities.description: Speech-to-Text conversion using System/Faster-Whisper engines. Toggleable listening.
capabilities.verification_step: Press F4, check status bar mic indicator toggles ON/OFF.

capabilities.description: Manual activation of the microphone. Server-side via hotkey (Ctrl+Shift) or F8 toggle. Client-side via WebRTC Browser MediaRecorder.
capabilities.verification_step: Press F8 to enable server PTT, or hold tap WebUI mic icon to test WebRTC upload.
capabilities.notes: WebRTC PTT uses pydub backend conversion to map remote Mobile Dictation to standard Hecos STT.

capabilities.description: Standalone local Fish Speech S2-Pro FastAPI daemon (port 18480) with zero-duplicate meta-device CUDA weight streaming, mid-token disconnect/cancel abort, VRAM paging telemetry, and lifecycle decoupled from global active_engine for Voice Forge Studio.
capabilities.verification_step: Keep Piper or Kokoro as Active TTS Engine, start Fish Speech server from Voice Forge bar, synthesize audio, and verify active_engine remains unchanged.
capabilities.notes: Supports start, stop (free VRAM), restart, and cancel (abort in-flight synthesis without unloading weights).
